text:
From what I understand, PIBA will generally recognise the paternity of an Israeli father without a court order or genetic testing if your marriage occurred more than 300 days before the birth. If not, then DNA testing and a legal process may be required. 

At the hospital, I think you get a temporary ID number for the baby, and then you will need to go to PIBA after the birth to register the baby and sort out their status.
